purpose: Separate DPF completeness within the complete observable rendered-chat scope from provider-native exact-context completeness, without weakening ChatBridge truth boundaries or cleanup proof requirements.

full_observable_rendered_chat.meaning: All rendered user/assistant/system/tool-visible events in the declared browser scope are hash-valid, gap-free and reconstructable for the observed range.

provider_native_exact.meaning: Provider-native source completeness under the strict ChatBridge full-fidelity ledger contract.

truth_boundary: FULL_OBSERVABLE_RENDERED_CHAT may be verified for DPF provenance while PROVIDER_NATIVE_EXACT remains false. No hidden provider event, browser installation, live egress, current-chat capture, cleanup effect, Design Gene promotion, provider authority or runtime maturity is inferred from this source contract.
